page: Microsoft Azure DC32ads_v6 is a virtual machine instance belonging to the DCadsv6 server family. It is powered by an AMD x86_64 processor and features 32 dedicated vCPUs. The instance is configured with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per virtual core.

This server type includes 1229 GB of local disk storage and is capable of utilizing Premium Storage. It runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The configuration does not include any integrated GPU hardware or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given the balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and the inclusion of substantial local storage, this instance is suitable for general-purpose workloads, relational databases, and applications requiring dedicated CPU resources alongside local storage capacity.
